description: This file defines the InterviewAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, representing interview attachment records with properties such as filename, file content, size, and related interview entity. It utilizes Doctrine ORM for database mapping and includes accessor methods.

classes.name: InterviewAttachment
classes.description: Entity class for interview attachments, mapping to 'ohrm_job_interview_attachment' table with properties for file details and relation to Interview.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates an Interview entity with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the attachment, if set.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, either as resource or string.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getAttachmentType
methods.description: Returns the attachment type, if set.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the attachment.
